definitions.winRate: profitable completed holding cycles / all completed holding cycles
definitions.cycle: first buy until the ticker position returns to zero; partial sells matched FIFO
definitions.cycleReturn: net realized P&L after modeled costs / FIFO gross cost basis including buy costs
definitions.payoffRatio: arithmetic mean winning cycle return / absolute arithmetic mean losing cycle return
definitions.profitFactor: sum positive cycle P&L / absolute sum negative cycle P&L
definitions.annualAttribution: exit year of the completed holding cycle
definitions.currentYearProvisional: open cycles hypothetically sold at 2026-07-16 close with modeled sell costs
